CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Steven W. Huang, DDS, Mayor  www.CityofSanMarino.org
Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone

Tony Chou, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber

Calvin Lo, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Steve Talt, Council Member  San Marino, CA 91108

Philippe Eskandar, City Manager

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 13, 2024, AT 6:00 PM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org or by phone at
(626) 300-0705 prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City
will do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Visit www.CityofSanMarino.org/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:

  Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org until
  3:00 p.m. the day before the meeting. Written public comment received by 3:00
  p.m. will be distributed to City Council during the meeting. Any comments received

AGENDA – MARCH 13, 2024  PAGE 1 of 5
   after 3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but not provided to
  City Council at the meeting.
  Written public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us
  teleconference module during the meeting. Written Zoom comments will be accepted
  after the in-person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Council Member Talt, Vice Mayor Shepherd
Romey, and Mayor Huang

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At
this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to
place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the City Manager to inform the City Council and the public of any
upcoming events or matters of interest to the community.

  NEW BUSINESS

 1.  SELECTION OF FY 2024-25 PRIORITY INITIATIVE PROPOSALS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council engage in a discussion and
  give direction on which priority initiatives they would like staff to incorporate into the
  City’s Fiscal Year 2023-24 work plan and budget.

AGENDA – MARCH 13, 2024  PAGE 2 of 5
   CONSENT CALENDAR

 2.  ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. O-24-1411 (SECOND READING)
  AMENDING MUNICIPAL CODE SECTIONS 23.01.01 AND 23.02.25 TO
  IMPLEMENT STATE LAW REGARDING ACCESSORY DWELLING UNITS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council adopt Ordinance No. O-24-
  1411. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation an appropriate motion
  would be:

  “I move to adopt Ordinance No. O-24-1411, an Ordinance of the San Marino City
  Council amending Municipal Code Sections 23.01.01 and 23.02.25 to implement
  State law regarding accessory dwelling units.”

 3.  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R-24-03 AMENDING THE JOB
  CLASSIFICATIONS FOR THE POSITIONS OF POLICE RECORDS CLERK
  AND PART-TIME LIBRARY ASSISTANT

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. R-
  24-03. If Council concurs, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to adopt Resolution No. R-24-03, amending the job classifications for the
  positions of Police Records Clerk and part-time Library Assistant.

 4.  ADOPTION  OF  RESOLUTION  NO.  R-24-04 AMENDING  THE
  UNREPRESENTED EMPLOYEES SALARY AND BENEFITS SCHEDULE FOR
  THE PERIOD COVERING JULY 1, 2022, THROUGH JUNE 30, 2024,
  PERTAINING TO SICK LEAVE POLICY AND APPROPRIATE FUNDS IN
  THE AMOUNT OF $15,695

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. R-
  24-04, and direct Finance staff to increase each department’s operating budget in the
  necessary amount. If Council concurs, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to adopt Resolution No. R-24-04 amending Resolution No. R-23-23; and
  approve additional appropriations in the amount of $15,695 in FY 2023-2024 to be
  spread over the affected part-time personnel budget line items.”

 5.  ACCEPTANCE  OF  DONATIONS  TO  THE  POLICE  AND  FIRE
  DEPARTMENTS FROM THE CHINESE CLUB OF SAN MARINO

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council accept the donation and amend the
  San Marino Police and Fire Department budgets to reflect the donation and related
  expenditures. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate
  motion would be:

  “I move to (1) accept the donation of $20,000 from the Chinese Club of San Marino;
  (2) approve the fiscal year 2023-2024 revenue budget amendment of $10,000 in the

AGENDA – MARCH 13, 2024  PAGE 3 of 5
   Donations Fund (Acct. 281-30-3601-0000: Police Donations Received); (3) approve
  the fiscal year 2023-2024 revenue budget amendment of $10,000 in the Donations
  Fund (Acct. 281-34-3601-0000: Fire Donations Received); approve an expenditure
  budget amendment of $10,000 to account 281-30-4376-0000 (Materials & Supplies);
  and approve an expenditure budget amendment of $10,000 to account 281-34-4399-
  0000 (Non-Capitalized Equipment).”

 6.  APPROVAL OF A THREE YEAR AGREEMENT FOR MICROSOFT 365
  LICENSING

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council authorize the City Manager to
  execute a three-year agreement with Dell Corporation for Microsoft 365 licenses in an
  amount not-to-exceed $35,151.60 annually or $105,454.80 total.

 7.  APPROVAL OF THE INSTALLATION AND WAIVING OF COSTS FOR THE
  SAN MARINO SCHOOLS FOUNDATION OF STREET POLE BANNERS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the request from
  the San Marino Schools Foundation and waive the installation costs. If the City
  Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve a request from the San Marino Schools Foundation that is in
  accordance with Resolution No. R-14-22 for the installation and display of banners
  citywide between April 1 and June 30 of 2024.”

 8.  APPROVAL OF REQUEST TO WAIVE SPECIAL EVENT PERMIT FEES FOR
  THE 2024 JP BLECKSMITH RUN

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council waive the Special Event
  Permit fees associated with the JP Blecksmith Run. If the City Council agrees with
  staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to waive the Special Event Permit fees associated with the JP Blecksmith
  Run.”

 9.  CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE MONTH OF JANUARY 2024

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file this report. If the
  City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Cash and Investment Report for the month of January
  2024.”

 10. RECEIVE AND FILE  MONTHLY  DISBURSEMENTS  REPORT  FOR
  FEBRUARY 2024

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file the Monthly
  Disbursements Report for the month of February 2024. If the City Council concurs
  with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

AGENDA – MARCH 13, 2024  PAGE 4 of 5
   “I move to receive and file the Monthly Disbursements Report for the month of
  February 2024.”

 11. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the February 2024
  minutes. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate
  motion would be:

  “I move to approve the minutes of the special meeting of February 14, 2024, the
  regular meeting of February 14, 2024, the joint meeting with the Library Board of
  Trustees of February 23, 2024, the adjourned regular meeting of February 23, 2024,
  and the special meeting of February 23, 2024.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

ADJOURNMENT

Posted: 3/8/2024  ALISON WALKER
  CITY CLERK
